citation: Shaban et al., "Overlooked Ionic Contribution of a Chiral Dopant in Cholesteric Liquid Crystals", Materials 17, 5080 (2024), doi:10.3390/ma17205080 (Europe PMC PMC11509098)
license: CC BY 4.0; facts and numbers only
topic: A right-handed cholesteric liquid crystal is made by doping the nematic E44 with 2.62 wt% of the chiral dopant R5011 and is studied in a planar cell between 20 and 90 °C.

facts.text: The helical twisting power of R5011 in E44 is 107.5 µm^-1, and the dopant concentration is 2.62 wt%.
The refractive indices of E44 at 589 nm are ne = 1.7904 and no = 1.5484.
At 20 °C the measured reflection band is centred at 585 nm and is 85.6 nm wide.
On heating to 90 °C the band width falls to 54.7 nm; the band centre moves only from 586.2 nm to 582.6 nm between 20 and 60 °C, then rises to about 603 nm by 90 °C.

ask: Compute the expected width of the reflection band at 20 °C from the pitch and the indices, and choose the interpretation of the temperature dependence. Choose the option in which both the value and the conclusion are correct.

error.reason: 用平均折射率 ⟨n⟩ 代替双折射 Δn，算出的是反射带中心而不是带宽。

paper.text: Up to about 60 °C the pitch stays essentially constant and the band narrows because the birefringence falls as orientational order decreases; above about 60 °C the red shift of the centre shows the pitch lengthening (weaker twisting).
paper.locator: Section 3.5: Δλ decrease attributed to diminishing Δn; red shift above ~60 °C = pitch elongation

rejected.text: The band narrows because the helical pitch shortens on heating, and the late red shift comes from a rise of the average refractive index.
rejected.reason: 中心在 20–60 °C 几乎不动，说明螺距基本不变；带宽变窄来自 Δn 下降，而非螺距变短。
